data: Which of the following are parts of the architecture?

The architecture consists of two main components: the Context Encoder and the Keyphrase Tagger. The Context Encoder processes the conversation context, while the Keyphrase Tagger processes the target post. Both components are interconnected through the shared representation of the target post. The figure shows the flow of data and the interactions between these components.
